item.title: FCC Chairman’s Comments to Revoke Broadcast Licenses gets Pushback

item.title: Trump Urges Allies to Help with Strait of Hormuz as Oil, Gas Prices Soar Amid Iran’s Blockade
item.description: Global energy markets are feeling the impact of a major shipping blockade in the Middle East. Iran’s military has effectively shut down traffic through the Strait of Hormuz — a narrow waterway that carries about twenty percent of the world’s oil supply on a daily basis.

item.title: Michigan education leaders highlight literacy push during March Reading Month
item.description: Michigan education officials are using March Reading Month to highlight new literacy initiatives and teacher training programs aimed at improving reading outcomes for students. State leaders say investments in the science of reading, family engagement, and classroom support are key to reversing lagging reading scores.
